summary: A staff member asks a Tribal officer about the feature on the docket because an earlier objection named other places.
realLife: The Caddo Nation of Oklahoma’s preservation officer had objected to two other proposals. Staff sought specific comment on Anne des Cadeaux Bayou and Brevelle Branch and received no reply.
inGame: needs: the officer’s earlier response, the specific features it names and any reply to the new inquiry.

turns.what: The clerk asks about this particular case.
turns.writesBack: The earlier objection remains attached to its own proposal..

turns.pulledBy: The officer answers about this waterway.
turns.writesBack: The committee has a position specific to this docket..
